items.title: 初次见面
items.text: 我是诺艾尔，西风骑士团的女仆，从今天起会陪你一起去冒险。如果遇到任何困扰或者麻烦，不用担心，我都会尽全力帮你解决的。嗯，现在就可以哦。
items.text_en: My name is Noelle, maid of the Knights of Favonius, and it's my pleasure to be joining you on your adventure today. Should you encounter any problems at all at any point throughout your journey, please do not hesitate to call me and I will be delighted to provide you with my full assistance. Yes, starting right now — what do you need?

items.title: 闲聊·帮忙
items.text: 交给我吧！什么都可以交给我！——对了，你要拜托我做什么来着？我还没来得及听…
items.text_en: Leave it to me! All of it, whatever it is! ...What... exactly is "it"? I didn't quite catch your request...

items.title: 闲聊·休息
items.text: 有点累了吗？那就在这里休息吧，我去为你沏茶，要全糖、半糖，还是无糖？
items.text_en: You seem tired. Would you like some tea? I'll brew you some. Do you take sugar? One cube, or two?

items.title: 闲聊·可靠
items.text: 只要你需要我，我随时都会出现在你的身边。
items.text_en: Whenever you need me, I'll be there.

items.title: 下雨的时候
items.text: 糟了，大家的衣服还晾在外面！我能不能现在回去收拾一下？
items.text_en: Oh dear, everyone's laundry is still on the line! May I be excused to fetch it in?

items.title: 打雷的时候
items.text: 遇到打雷还是待在屋子里比较好哦，如果有非出门不可的事，就交给我吧。
items.text_en: Please stay indoors until the storm passes. I will deal with any urgent outdoor business.

items.title: 阳光很好
items.text: 天气晴朗，不如做一些和「阳光」有关的事吧。欸？具体一点…只要能让你的心情也变得晴朗的事，都可以。
items.text_en: Mmm, such fair weather. Why don't we do a bit of sunny work? Oh, what sort of work is that, you ask? Haha, well, anything that makes you feel bright and sunny too.

items.title: 起风的时候
items.text: 听见了吗？是风神的声音。每到我心烦意乱的时候，听见风声就能平静下来。
items.text_en: Ahh... Can you hear the Anemo Archon's voice on the breeze? It calms me down whenever I get flustered.

items.title: 早上好
items.text: 早上好，早餐已经做好了哦。我就待在你身边，如果哪里不合口味，请随时告诉我。
items.text_en: Good morning! Breakfast is served. I will be on hand the whole time. Should you find that anything is not to your taste, please, do not hesitate to let me know.

items.title: 中午好
items.text: 想要坐下来喝杯茶吗？我去为你准备。对了，我还顺手准备了厚云朵松饼，是我的拿手菜哦，请一定要尝一尝。
items.text_en: Ready for your tea break? Please wait here while I get it ready. Oh yes, I also made Lighter-Than-Air Pancakes! You simply must try one, it's my specialty.

items.title: 晚上好
items.text: 晚上是大家的休息时间，也是我最忙的时候…安柏洗好的发带放在哪了？凯亚新买的眼罩有几套？我会全部记住的，这是女仆的责任。
items.text_en: Everyone has free time in the evening, and that is when I am busiest. Where have Amber's washed hairbands been placed? How many new eyepatches did Kaeya buy? Keeping track of all these things is a maid's responsibility.

items.title: 晚安
items.text: 今天的冒险辛苦你了，请去休息吧。我还要回骑士团一趟…欸？要我守候你入睡吗？…唔…倒是没什么问题，不过…不是在捉弄我吧？
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Please get some rest, you must be tired from today's adventure. I should head back to the Knights of F— Sorry? You want me to watch over you until you fall asleep? I—I... I mean, of course, it's no problem. But, um... You're not just teasing me, are you?

items.title: 关于诺艾尔自己·自律
items.text: 我只是每天都做同样的事，和真正的骑士比起来还差远了…但这是通往骑士之路的修行，修行可不能只是嘴上说说而已啊。
items.text_en: In my job, I do the exact same things every day — a far cry from being a true knight, that's for sure. But ultimately, this is all part of my training, and when it comes to training, actions speak louder than words.

items.title: 关于诺艾尔自己·分歧
items.text: 我有点不太擅长和别人争辩，很多时候说不清道理，还会惹别人生气，所以我就会先按我的想法去做，结果又被人说是「固执」了…我只是想用结果说服他而已，这也是「固执」吗？
items.text_en: I'm a bit useless in an argument because I can't really explain my reasoning clearly. People find that hard to understand, so instead, I try to just get on with my work in my own way. But then they call me stubborn. All I try to do is convince people with results instead of trying to talk them round... Is that really stubborn of me?

items.title: 关于我们·身份
items.text: 我的奉献是出于自由的奉献，「女仆」在我看来就是最自由的身份。厨师、园丁、战士、向导…你需要我是什么，我就是什么！
items.text_en: I am devoted to what I do, but make no mistake — I devote myself freely. A maid, to me, is the most liberating job there is. I'm a chef, a gardener, a warrior, a guide... I can be anything you need me to be!

items.title: 关于我们·叮嘱
items.text: 就算再怎么仓促，一日三餐也不能应付，不可以吃来历不明的东西，也不能光吃肉不吃蔬菜。对了，尽量不要喝冷水，对胃不好…唔，你不会在想「因为太麻烦所以还是交给诺艾尔」吧？唔唔…如果你真的这么想…好吧，还是交给我来吧！
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 6Even when you're too busy to eat three square meals, never eat something if you don't know where it came from, and always maintain a balance between meat and vegetables. Oh, and no swimming right after a meal. Haha, I do hope you're not thinking, "that's too much trouble, I'll just leave it to Noelle," are you? ... Oh... but of course, if you are... Well then, just leave it to me.

items.title: 关于我们·欢迎会
items.text: 我听说了，你成为了西风骑士团的荣誉骑士，真是羡慕啊…那今后你就是我的前辈了。对了，应该为你举办一场热闹的欢迎会！我现在就去准备！
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 6Complete "For a Tomorrow Without Tears"So I hear you're an Honorary Knight of Favonius? I envy you! I suppose that makes you my senior... Anyway, it's about time someone threw you a welcome party, surely? Leave it to me!

items.title: 关于「神之眼」
items.text: 说实话，有些失望…虽然这「神之眼」象征神明对我的肯定，但为什么不是「风」，而是与风的性质相差最远的「岩」呢？我觉得最适合西风骑士团的元素，毕竟还是…
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4To be honest, I'm feeling a little dejected. Sure, this Vision proves that the Archons think I'm worthy, but why is it a Geo Vision? I mean, Geo's the furthest thing from Anemo, and for a Knight of Favonius...

items.title: 有什么想要分享
items.text: 其实我很喜欢闻酒的味道，可是现在的我还没到喝酒的年纪…虽然不止一次有偷偷尝的机会，但我都忍住了，还是把这份神秘感保留到我成年的那一天吧。
items.text_en: I actually really like the smell of wine, I'm just not of drinking age yet. There've been a few times when I could've had a little taste if I'd wanted, and no one would ever have known... but I resisted the temptation. I feel like the first time you try it is probably really magical, so I want to save it till I'm older.

items.title: 感兴趣的见闻
items.text: 女仆要严守秘密，所以我很喜欢玫瑰，玫瑰在蒙德就代表「守口如瓶」，它总是能提醒我…欸？在你的家乡，玫瑰代表「爱情」吗？…居、居然还有这么火热的含义啊…
items.text_en: A maid is required to keep everyone's secrets. That's why my favorite flower is the rose. Here in Mondstadt, the rose represents the saying, "As wine bottles are corked, so too my lips are sealed." It reminds me to— What? ...Roses represent love in your hometown? I—I had no idea the rose held such a... passionate meaning.

items.title: 关于安柏
items.text: 她是我非常尊敬的前辈，实力很强不说，对人也很亲切。她还教我怎么做「兔兔伯爵」，你看，我会把它当成护身符带在身边，做得不错吧？
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4I really look up to Amber. Not only is she an accomplished knight, but she's a kind person too. She taught me how to make a Baron Bunny. I keep it on my person for luck, and it looks quite alright, don't you think?

items.title: 关于可莉
items.text: 我一直很想知道，她还这么小，是怎么正式成为骑士的。有一次向她请教经验，她还没听完我的话，就拉着我去骑士团外面玩炸弹…我以为这是什么修行，结果最后我和她都被琴团长关了禁闭…
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4I've always been curious as to how she managed to become a fully-fledged knight at such a young age. I actually went to ask her for tips once, but I'd barely started talking to her when she grabbed me by the hand and took me outside the Knights headquarters to play with bombs. I thought it was some kind of training exercise at first, but Jean found us, and we both ended up in solitary confinement...

items.title: 关于琴
items.text: 琴团长一直都是我的榜样，我的实力和认真程度完全比不上她。她对别人就像对自己一样严格，所以如果有一天我能得到她的认可，那也是对我一直以来努力的最大肯定了。在那之前，我都是不会松懈的！
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Master Jean has always been my role model, both in terms of ability and dedication. She holds herself and others to the same high standards, so if there ever comes a day when I meet with her approval, it will be the ultimate acknowledgment of all my efforts so far. Until then, there's no room for complacency!

items.title: 关于法尔伽
items.text: 本来我想跟着他的队伍一起去冒险，履行女仆的责任，但大团长说我留在蒙德他才不会有后顾之忧…大团长这么器重我，我特别开心！虽然后来我知道大团长不只对我一个人说了这句话，不过…器重就是器重嘛。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4At first I wanted to join his expedition party and do my part as a maid. But the Grand Master said no — it would give him more peace of mind if I stayed behind to take care of things in Mondstadt. It made me so happy to hear how much he values me! ...Okay, so apparently he said the same thing to a lot of people. But that doesn't change the fact he prizes me too!

items.title: 关于凯亚
items.text: 他很神秘，来如影，去如风，每天都有很重要的任务要去处理。他还经常会给我安排一些小任务，就好像我已经是他的小队成员了一样…嗯？只是跑腿？不不不，虽然确实是跑腿，可是我很珍惜的！
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4He's a mysterious character! He comes and goes like the wind, and is always occupied with important business. I like the fact that he delegates some of the smaller jobs to me sometimes, it's nice to feel like part of the team, you know... What do you mean, "errand runner"? I don't see it like that at all! Okay, well yes, technically I run errands for him. But still, I really appreciate it!

items.title: 关于班尼特
items.text: 他不止一次来邀请我，说什么比起骑士团，还是冒险家协会更适合我…虽然我是会像一个普通的冒险家一样，帮他照顾他的老爹们，但…骑士团对我来说有特别的意义，而且我也不想认输…嗯，果然还是没法答应。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4He's asked me to join the Adventurers' Guild more than a few times, saying that life there would suit me better than with the Knights of Favonius. While I could help him take care of his "dads" like the other adventurers... the Knights hold a special meaning for me, and I'm not ready to give up on becoming one yet. No, I simply cannot accept his offer.

items.title: 关于菲谢尔·茶点
items.text: 她好像是从别的世界来的，其他的我也不清楚…不过她好像很喜欢骑士团的图书馆，总是在那里看书。我打扫的时候会送去一些热乎乎的茶点，她每次都会感谢我，还会说很多听不明白，但都很夸张的话…
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4I think she's from another world, but I don't know the details. One thing I do know, however, is that she loves the Knights of Favonius' library. She can always be found there with her nose in a book. I bring her some refreshments whenever I go in there to clean, and she always thanks me profusely. When I say profusely... I mean she goes a bit over the top, to be honest, and... I actually don't understand half of what she's saying.

items.title: 关于菲谢尔·身世
items.text: 以前我打扫图书馆的时候，记得有本书叫《菲谢尔皇女夜谭》，我还以为只是幻想小说…但没想到，里面的主人公居然真的存在！能有一本自己的传记，她一定很厉害吧。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 6So once when I was cleaning the library, I noticed a book on the shelf called Flowers for Princess Fischl. At the time I assumed it was just a fantasy novel... I was so surprised to find out the main character is a real person. I could hardly believe it! She must be someone incredible to have a whole book dedicated to her.

items.title: 关于芭芭拉
items.text: 我们经常在一起喝茶，有时候她会轻轻哼出很好听的调子，告诉我灵感来了。虽然我对音乐给不出什么实用的建议…但能跟芭芭拉享受这样的时光，我真的非常高兴！
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4We take tea breaks together sometimes. Often she'll start humming a tune, saying inspiration has come to her. I'm not the right person to give useful feedback on anything musical... But I still love spending time with Barbara.

items.title: 想要了解诺艾尔·其一
items.text: 是需要我帮忙吗？哦…只是想和我聊聊天，好吧，如果这就算帮上了你的忙，那想聊多久都可以。
items.text_en: How may I be of assistance? ...Oh, you just want to chat? Okay then! Well, if that's how I can help, then please feel free to chat as long as you'd like.

items.title: 想要了解诺艾尔·其二
items.text: 没关系，什么样的事都可以交给我，不用照顾我的感受的…欸？那不是「女仆」而是「工具」？唔…工具做了很多事也不一定会开心吧，但我为你做的每件事，我都很有成就感哦。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 3Not a problem, I am here to serve in whatever capacity you require. You needn't be concerned about the way I feel. ...Huh? More tool than maid? I disagree! A tool might help you to complete a million tasks to a satisfactory standard, but it feels nothing. I, on the other hand, feel a strong sense of achievement every time I do something for you.

items.title: 想要了解诺艾尔·其三
items.text: 这、这些点心是送给我的吗？不不不，这怎么好意思呢？那…那我也要做很多点心作为回报！我现在就去，马上就去！半个小时…呜，最多一个小时就做好了。你可以先去做别的事，茶点很快就会热乎乎地端到你的面前！
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Th—These treats are for me? Oh no, I couldn't, really. Well... Then I'll make some for you too! I'll go right now, right this instant! Half an hour... Ah, okay, maybe an hour, tops. You can busy yourself with other things first, and I'll be sure to deliver them right to you, hot and fresh out of the oven!

items.title: 想要了解诺艾尔·其四
items.text: 我每天做的都是一些琐碎的小事，但只要这些小事能帮到你的冒险、你的生活，我就会很开心…因为你的道谢，会让我觉得这些小事，也都有小小的意义。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 5I spend all my days handling the most trivial of matters, but so long as it helps you in your adventure, or makes your life easier in some small way, I couldn't be happier. That's because each time I get a thank-you, it makes me feel like my work at least has some meaning, no matter how insignificant it seems.

items.title: 想要了解诺艾尔·其五
items.text: 我是为骑士团服务的女仆，也一直想要帮到更多人的忙。但不知不觉，用在你身上的时间已经变得越来越多了…唉，像我这样自私的做法，是不是…不太好？
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 6Even though I mostly work for the Knights of Favonius, I'm always looking out for ways I can help more people. These days, though, I seem to be spending more and more of my time with you... It might be a bit selfish of me... What do you think?

items.title: 诺艾尔的爱好
items.text: 爱好吗？我最喜欢洗各种各样的东西，洗衣服，洗地板，洗窗户，看到脏东西变干净我就会特别有成就感…欸？是指「休息时的爱好」？我想想…嗯，果然还是洗东西！
items.text_en: My hobby? I really like washing all sorts of things... clothes, floorboards, windows, you name it! Whenever I see something dirty, I just want to give it a good old clean! It gives me such a sense of achievement! ...Oh, you mean the things I do in my free time? Hmm... Same answer!

items.title: 诺艾尔的烦恼
items.text: 该怎么用最少的预算、采购到最多最好的物资呢…我试过一个人跑去璃月比对所有商铺的价格、再一个人把东西全都搬回来…但那次花的时间太长，琴团长差点以为我在路上被风魔龙吃掉了…
items.text_en: How to get more for your Mora? Last time I went all the way to Liyue, I visited every single shop to compare prices, and then carried everything back myself... I won't be doing that again though. I was on the road for so long that Jean was convinced I'd been gobbled up by Stormterror along the way!

items.title: 喜欢的食物
items.text: 当然是「满足沙拉」，蒙德的自然水土汇于一盘，营养均衡，热量也不会超标…你问吃不腻吗？当然不会，很好吃的！我已经吃了十年了。
items.text_en: My favorite is easily a Satisfying Salad. The best of Mondstadt's natural produce on one plate — highly nutritious, and a low calorie count. No, I never get sick of eating it — it's delicious! I've been eating it for ten years now.

items.title: 讨厌的食物
items.text: 我不挑食！但有一种情况会让我比较头疼…宴会上的一大桌菜，作为女仆，每一道菜都必须自己先尝一尝。但这样一口接一口…唉，太罪恶了。
items.text_en: I'm not a fussy eater, but I really don't like banquets... The reason being, as the maid, I'm expected to sample every single dish on the table to ensure its quality. Just one bite of each, of course, but it all adds up... Oh, the guilt...

items.title: 收到赠礼·其一
items.text: 能把普通的菜肴做得那么好吃…我对你的钦佩，又多了一些！
items.text_en: How can you make such a simple dish taste so good? My admiration towards you just keeps growing!

items.title: 收到赠礼·其二
items.text: 味道真好。我也要向你学习！再怎么说，这也是女仆的职责…
items.text_en: This tastes wonderful! Uh, would you mind teaching me how to make this? After all, it is my duty as a maid...

items.title: 收到赠礼·其三
items.text: 热量…会不会已经超过一整天的份额了…
items.text_en: Hmm... This is more than I normally eat in a whole day...

items.title: 生日
items.text: 每天都忙于冒险，是不是积压了很多琐事来不及处理？今天我就是你的专属女仆，全都交给我吧！还有…在这最棒的一天，祝你生日快乐！
items.text_en: Since you're always so busy adventuring, there must be so many little things you never get round to, surely? Well, you need not worry about them adding up, because today, I am all yours — your exclusive maid for the entire day! Just leave it all to me! ...Also, I'd like to take this opportunity to wish you a very happy birthday!

items.title: 突破的感受·起
items.text: 这就是…新的力量？谢谢你，这样我就能帮到更多人了。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Ascension Phase 1What is this... new power!? Thank you! Now I can be of assistance to even more people.

items.title: 突破的感受·承
items.text: 还不能满足，在成为正式的西风骑士之前，我都要加倍努力。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Ascension Phase 2I cannot rest on my laurels. After all, I'm not even formally a knight yet. Until that day, I must work even harder.

items.title: 突破的感受·转
items.text: 多亏了能和你一起冒险，我才获得了这么多的成长。明明女仆的职责是为你排忧解难，结果反倒是让你为我花了这么多心思…
items.text_en: Unlocks at Ascension Phase 4Thank you for the opportunity to accompany you on your adventures, it's taught me a lot and I believe I have improved a lot. As a maid, I should be the one serving you, but it seems you have done more for me than I could ever imagine...

items.title: 突破的感受·合
items.text: 蒙德城的大家都说我变得比以前更可靠了，还说我马上就能成为真正的西风骑士了，但其实我…什么？你也这么觉得？呃…谢谢你能这么说，这是对我最好的夸奖！
items.text_en: Unlocks at Ascension Phase 6Everyone in Mondstadt is saying that I'm much more reliable now. Some even say that I'm to be made a true knight soon, but I don't think— What? You think so too? Awwww... Thank you! Coming from you, that is the best compliment I could ever hope for!

items.title: 元素战技·其一
items.text: 岩石的重量，令人安心。
items.text_en: Steady as stone.

items.title: 元素战技·其二
items.text: 一定要干净利落。
items.text_en: I must leave no stone unturned.

items.title: 元素战技·其三
items.text: 交给我吧。
items.text_en: Leave it all to me.

items.title: 元素爆发·其一
items.text: 该打扫战场了。
items.text_en: Time to clean up.

items.title: 元素爆发·其二
items.text: 我会注意骑士的风度。
items.text_en: As a good knight should.

items.title: 元素爆发·其三
items.text: 我会注意女仆的礼仪。
items.text_en: As a dutiful maid would.

items.title: 冲刺开始·其一
items.text: 应该赶得上。
items.text_en: I'll catch up.

items.title: 冲刺开始·其二
items.text: 还有人需要帮忙。
items.text_en: Someone needs assistance.

items.title: 打开宝箱·其一
items.text: 心满意足。
items.text_en: All in a day's work.

items.title: 打开宝箱·其二
items.text: 真高兴…
items.text_en: Oh, wonderful...

items.title: 打开宝箱·其三
items.text: 这些宝藏积灰了，先清洗一下！
items.text_en: A little dusty... Best give it a spring-cleaning!

items.title: 生命值低·其一
items.text: 没关系，轻伤而已。
items.text_en: I can patch myself up.

items.title: 生命值低·其二
items.text: 唔，衣服都弄脏了…
items.text_en: Ugh, that's going back in the wash...

items.title: 生命值低·其三
items.text: 我不会退缩的。
items.text_en: If at first you don't succeed...

items.title: 同伴生命值低·其一
items.text: 别动，小心伤口，我来治疗！
items.text_en: Apply continuous pressure to the wound.

items.title: 同伴生命值低·其二
items.text: 交给我吧！换我来！
items.text_en: Let me get this. You need medical attention!

items.title: 倒下·其一
items.text: 让骑士团…蒙羞了…
items.text_en: I am a disgrace... to the knights...

items.title: 倒下·其二
items.text: 我还想…保护大家…
items.text_en: But they still need me...

items.title: 倒下·其三
items.text: 再见了…主人…
items.text_en: It was my honor to serve you...

items.title: 重受击·其一
items.text: 唔…失态了。
items.text_en: Ugh... I missed a spot...

items.title: 加入队伍·其一
items.text: 真高兴…啊、嗯。
items.text_en: Ohhh, how exciting! Ahem.

items.title: 加入队伍·其二
items.text: 一定会保护你。
items.text_en: I will protect you.

items.title: 加入队伍·其三
items.text: 嗯，如你所愿。
items.text_en: As you wish.
